summary: Satellos Bioscience Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on May 27, 2026, attaching a press release announcing management's participation in two upcoming investor conferences: the Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference on June 4, 2026, in New York, and the Oppenheimer CNS Neuro-Muscular Summit on June 10, 2026, in Miami. The release provides details on the presentations and one-on-one meeting availability. This is a routine event notice with no special-situation transaction or structural change. As a foreign private issuer filing under Form 40-F, the filing is an ordinary periodic report. No deal terms, board recommendations, or strategic actions are mentioned. The filing is purely informational about investor relations activities.
